raw_blocks: Train and Deploy Industry‑Leading Generative and Traditional AI.
Data and AI are inextricably linked. We bring 36+ years of data and domain expertise to your AI initiatives. Seven of the world’s largest tech companies trust Innodata for their AI needs.
Develop data to train and refine existing and pre-trained models for task taxonomies. Create large-scale training datasets and golden datasets for supervised fine-tuning.
Rely on human experts-in-the-loop to improve hallucinations and edge-cases with ongoing feedback to achieve optimal model performance.
Address model vulnerabilities, rigorously test and optimize models to ensure safety and compliance, expose model weaknesses, and improve responses to real-world threats.
Collect or create diverse datasets tailored to your needs through natural collection, synthetic generation, studio capture, and on-the-ground collection to train generative AI models.

Coming Soon: Develop advanced LLMs with our GenAI Platform for supervised fine-tuning, prompt writing, response annotation, RLHF model evaluation, and red teaming for rigorous prompt testing to ensure LLM safety.

Utilize our team of subject matter experts to deliver accurate, secure, reliable, and domain-specific data annotation services across all data types, including image, video, sensor (LiDAR), text, document audio, and speech data.
Collect or create diverse datasets tailored to your needs through natural collection, synthetic generation, studio capture, and on-the-ground collection to train traditional AI models.
Enable your teams to label data at scale with our web-based annotation platform for record classification, document classification, inline classification, and image annotation.

Align with your business objectives, define automation roadmaps, conduct vision workshops, and find where AI can foster innovation within your organization with Innodata’s AI consultation services. We bring design thinking and strategic planning to establish the right balance of person/machine synergy.

Leverage cutting-edge AI data services for AIOps, CoPilots, and advanced model development with data augmentation, human preference feedback, data for fine-tuning, model configuration and integration, and rigorous model safety, evaluation, and red teaming practices.

Transform your digital infrastructure with our cloud migration, legacy app modernization, and product design services. We help you upgrade outdated systems, modernize legacy apps, and design innovative products to enhance efficiency, performance, and long-term sustainability.

Streamline operations with our workflow automation and managed services. We design automated AI processes tailored to your business, reducing manual tasks and improving efficiency. Our solutions help you scale effortlessly, enabling your teams to focus on innovation and growth.
Utilize our out-of-the-box or industry-specific pre-trained AI models to extract data from any complex document in seconds, enabling powerful automation of document-heavy workflows.

Find journalists and influencers with our media database, monitor media coverage and mentions, measure performance with analytic solutions, and write and release content with generative AI-enabled newswire services.

Extract and analyze medical record data with our AI-enabled platform, allowing you to review medical records with greater efficiency and effectiveness, and create a foundational data layer to enable AI-augmented underwriting.
A Trusted Partner with Leading AI Companies

We could not have developed the scale of the current classifiers without Innodata. The average info worker team can’t deal with documents at scale and speed, so Al classifiers for auto-labeling are required; to meet this requirement we needed a huge corpus of sample documents across dozens of business categories. We went from basically no Al classifiers to 70 Classes in less than a year – from zero to exceeding compete parity. I don’t think there would have been another way to do that without the data corpus. I’m unaware of any other partner than Innodata that could have done that with the speed, volume, accuracy, and flexibility we needed.
STEM and Industry-Specific Domain Expertise

With over 11,500 in-house subject matter experts spanning STEM and industry-specific domains such as healthcare, finance, and legal, along with specialized experts like linguists and taxonomists, Innodata provides industry-leading subject matter expertise for any enterprise-grade AI development.
Quick Turnaround at Scale with Quality Results
Our globally distributed teams guarantee swift delivery of high-quality results 24/7, allowing rapid scalability in local expansion and globalization across projects of any size and complexity.
Global Delivery Locations & Language Capabilities
Innodata operates in 20+ global delivery locations with proficiency in over 120 native languages and dialects, ensuring comprehensive language coverage for your AI projects.

Benefit from our proprietary AI SaaS platforms, including our GenAI Workbench (coming soon) for advanced LLM development, our no-code/low-code Annotation Platform for scalable data labeling, and our Document Intelligence for complex data extraction from complex documents.

pages.raw_title: Federal AI Solutions for Defense, Intelligence and Civilian Agencies
pages.raw_meta: Mission-critical AI for U.S. government - data engineering, GenAI fine-tuning, agentic AI & model evaluation, delivered by a cleared STEM workforce with NIST 800-171 compliance.
raw_blocks: Accelerating AI Innovation Across U.S. Government
Innodata Federal is a new business unit of Innodata Inc. (NASDAQ: INOD) dedicated to helping government agencies harness the power of artificial intelligence.

We bring proven commercial AI solutions trusted by the world’s leading technology companies to U.S. government missions. Our teams support defense, intelligence, and civilian operations with security clearances, compliance readiness, and enterprise-scale delivery.
Full-Spectrum AI Solutions for Government Missions​
Proven Commercial Solutions, Purpose-Built for Federal Missions
AI Data Engineering & Model Training
High-accuracy data collection, annotation, and curation for computer vision, NLP, and multimodal AI systems. Supports imagery analysis, autonomous systems, sensor fusion, and more.
End-to-end support for LLM development and deployment, including supervised fine-tuning, RLHF, reward modeling, prompt engineering, RAG development, and more.
Agentic AI & Intelligent Automation
AI copilots and autonomous agents that streamline government workflows—from benefits adjudication to intelligence triage—with human oversight and compliance.
Model Safety, Evaluation & Red Teaming
Comprehensive testing, evaluation, and adversarial red teaming to identify vulnerabilities, ensure robustness, and verify compliance with federal AI ethics frameworks.
Certified, registered, and ready to deliver through federal acquisition channels.
RCA – Orange County – Region 4
Software Solutions and Services OMNIA Partners, Public Sector
TIPS – Technology Solutions Products and Services
E&I Carahsoft Cloud Solutions & Services Distributor Contract
Certifications: ISO 9001, ISO 27001, SSAE 16 Type II, NIST 800-171, HIPAA/DPA Compliant
Rapid-response teams mobilize within 24–48 hours to deliver production-ready AI solutions at commercial speed without compromising on quality, compliance, or security.
U.S. personnel with active security clearances and advanced STEM expertise in data science, linguistics, and engineering execute sensitive projects with precision and mission understanding.
Security & Compliance You Can Trust

Certified and compliant with ISO 27001, ISO 9001, SSAE 16 Type II, NIST 800-171, and HIPAA/DPA standards—Innodata Federal upholds the highest levels of data protection and readiness for CMMC and classified work.
Enterprise Scale & Full AI Lifecycle

As a NASDAQ-listed company with 20+ global delivery centers, Innodata brings the scale and financial stability to support the complete AI lifecycle—from data strategy and model training to deployment, safety testing, and sustainment.
Tell us what you’re building, share your objectives, and the Innodata Federal Team will connect with you to discuss the path forward.
